# Google Growth

> Open-source MCP server for GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console and AI-search readiness — free URL read, full GEO audit, GTM measurement plan.

## Product

- [Landing page](https://geoking2104.github.io/Google-Growth/): free URL read, then the full audit and assisted GTM engagement
- [Version française](https://geoking2104.github.io/Google-Growth/fr/): lecture gratuite de l’URL, puis audit complet et accompagnement GTM
- [Sample report](https://geoking2104.github.io/Google-Growth/reports/opendpe.html): full audit of opendpe.net, 71/100 with platform readiness and the fix plan
- [Repository](https://github.com/Geoking2104/Google-Growth): Apache-2.0, Node.js 20+
- [GEO rubric](https://github.com/Geoking2104/Google-Growth/blob/main/docs/GEO.md): eight categories, 100 points, evidence per check
- [GTM implementation guide](https://github.com/Geoking2104/Google-Growth/blob/main/docs/GTM_IMPLEMENTATION.md): snippets, dataLayer, consent, verification
